summary: Iteration 2 tested the new Actions CRUD, Day History, Shareable Finale and new-game confirm sheet, plus a regression check. Backend: 25/25 pytest passed, including 6 new tests in test_actions_history.py. Two tests in test_traitors_game.py still used ?force=true and now use a finish_setup helper. Frontend (375x667 web preview): every requested flow worked and there were no page errors. Actions screen: add, edit, delete, save (actions-saved), and reset through the confirm sheet all worked, and so did the min-3 error and back navigation. Both entry points (welcome-actions-button and menu-actions-button) open it. History: history-empty shows before the first reveal. history-day-N cards show the murder victim and action, a failed murder, and the banishment with its vote tally. Both entry points (menu-history-button and ended-history-button) work. Finale: the winner, the 4 days · 5 players · 1 Traitors line, and each player's role with Murdered/Banished on Day N or Survived to the end all matched the backend history. The web share button shows the 'Open the app on your phone' message. new-game-button opens a confirm sheet: Cancel keeps the game, confirm deletes it and returns to the welcome screen. Regression: setup -> Day 1 -> Round Table -> reveal -> Day 2 works through the dashboard buttons (votes cast via API). Only cosmetic issues found. Deprecated packages detected: none (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner and expo-background-fetch are not used). Native WhatsApp capture/share (react-native-view-shot + expo-sharing) cannot be tested on web.

ui_bugs.issue: Wrong plural: shows '1 Traitors' when there is a single traitor. Reference: /app/frontend/app/finale.tsx:55-56

issues: The web info message ('Open the app on your phone...') uses ErrorText, so it shows as a red error box. It is informational and should use a neutral or info style.
At 375px the 'Share the final verdict' label wraps onto 2 lines inside the button. Shorten it (e.g. 'Share the verdict') or let it fit on one line.
The display font (Cormorant) renders 'Day 1' with old-style numerals, so it can read as 'Day I'. Consider lining numerals or a different font for the day number.

action_items: Pluralize the traitor count on the finale card ('1 Traitor' vs '2 Traitors').
Show the finale web-share message in a neutral/info style instead of ErrorText.
Optional: stop the 'Share the final verdict' label wrapping at 375px; check the readability of the History day numerals.
critical_code_review_comments: finale.tsx renders an empty View when no game exists and shows everyone as Faithful (roles are null) if /finale is opened before the game ends. It is only reachable from the ended card, but a guard or redirect would be safer.
If actions are edited mid-game, pick_action draws from the current list. used_actions may hold old strings, which is harmless.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/ui_seed.py (new helper for driving UI test state)
seed_data_creation: TEST_P1..P5 games were created via API for the UI tests. Cleanup done at the end: DELETE /api/game (exists:false) and DELETE /api/actions (is_default:true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (single global game, so tests run in order). ui_seed.py commands: setup (5 players, setup turns done), votes (everyone votes in roundtable), to_end (play until ended), state. The app auto-routes to /reveal when phase=reveal. The ConfirmSheet is an RN Modal with a fade, so wait about 500ms before taking a screenshot.
